assets.service: overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

standby attendance and non-entry rescue capability

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unplanned release of chemical energy at PSV-4111

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control CONFINED_SPACE_ENTRY_PERMIT: the classification of a space and issue of an entry permit had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

Control STANDBY_ATTENDANCE_AND_RESCUE: the standby attendance and non-entry rescue capability was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the classification of a space and issue of an entry permit on PSV-4111 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in authorising and controlling entry, specifically standby attendance and entry logging. PSV-4111 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the classification of a space and issue of an entry permit had been bypassed. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 9 April 2023 a high potential incident was recorded on PSV-4111 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a breakdown response; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
